question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is 'even'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The given blank needs **an adverb** to describe the succeeding **verb see.**
 
• Off the given options only **clear **and **even **are adverbs. 
 
• **Clear **means so as to be out of the way of or away from.
 
• **Even **means used to emphasize something surprising or extreme.
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that **even **or **option 4 **is the best fit word for the given blank. 

*Correct passage - **She was flying over the hills and felt delighted at the (1) sight of the tall trees and their (2) sloping branches below her. She could (3) **even **see a river flowing in a zig-zag fashion. Birds (4) **flew **alongside making chirruping sounds as if (5) **welcoming **her to the skies.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Much **is a **determiner.**
 
• **Either **is a **conjunction. **
